reason: I travel a lot and sleep badly in hotels, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is a real fit. The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code make me less nervous about a random TikTok supplement, and $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium can be hit or miss, and I don't want to find out after 30 days that I wasted money on something that does nothing for me.
